verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's registered-agent service documents reminders as annual report deadlines approach, delivered as email through its Compliance Calendar. Its compliance plans add real-time compliance-status notifications based on state filing-office data. Franchise tax deadline alerts are not mentioned anywhere, and nothing confirms alerts are tracked per state across every state where LegalZoom is the agent. Missing for 10: franchise tax deadline alerts, explicit multi-state per-jurisdiction coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reminders.
